newsitem.title: USA: Biomatrix Synvisc recommended for FDA ok.
newsitem.headline: Biomatrix Synvisc recommended for FDA ok.

text.p: An advisory panel of the Food and Drug Administration has recommended approval of Biomatrix Inc's premarket application for Synvisc, a treatment for osteoarthritis of the knee, Biomatrix said Thursday.
The panel gave its recommendation on condition that a postmarket clinical study be performed, Biomatrix said.
Final FDA approval will be required before the company can begin the U.S. launch of Synvisc, a fluid injected into arthritic knee joints to relieve pain and improve mobility.
Biomatrix shares were halted for news pending at 1334 EDT Wednesday with a last sale of 15-1/2.
